name: Nissan Skyline GT-R (R34)
h1: Nissan Skyline GT-R R34 (BNR34): specs, RB26 engine and what owners say

us.x: Never sold new in the US. The first R34 GT-Rs became legal to import under the 25-year rule in January 2024, each car once it is 25 years old by its month of build. Before that, a few came in under the Show or Display exemption.

films.x: Brian O'Conner's silver R34 GT-R with blue stripes, which he races in the film's opening street race. The hero car was a real GT-R lent by the film's technical advisor.

related.t: Nissan GT-R (R35, sold in the US)

gens.tag: 2.6-liter twin-turbo RB26DETT, 280 PS (276 hp), 6-speed Getrag, all-wheel drive. Japan only.

hp.note: 280 PS at 6,800 rpm, Japan’s gentlemen’s agreement figure (JDM)

trans.note: Getrag; ATTESA E-TS with a mechanical rear differential

variants.name: Skyline GT-R V-spec

hp.note: 280 PS at 6,800 rpm, Japan’s gentlemen’s agreement figure (JDM)

trans.note: Getrag; ATTESA E-TS Pro with an active rear limited-slip differential

variants.what: Its own aero parts, tuned suspension and the ATTESA E-TS Pro system with an active rear limited-slip differential.

variants.name: Skyline GT-R V-spec II

hp.note: 280 PS at 6,800 rpm, Japan’s gentlemen’s agreement figure (JDM)

variants.what: Replaced the V-spec in October 2000: carbon hood with a NACA duct, aluminum pedals and stiffer suspension.

variants.name: Skyline GT-R M-spec

hp.note: 280 PS at 6,800 rpm, Japan’s gentlemen’s agreement figure (JDM)

variants.what: Based on the V-spec II, with "ripple control" dampers, a revised suspension setup and a leather interior with heated front seats.

variants.name: Skyline GT-R Nür (V-spec II Nür, M-spec Nür)
variants.what: The last R34s, built in 2002: an N1-based engine with balanced pistons and rods, and a gold cam cover. Wikipedia counts 1,003 built.

RB26DETT.name: Nissan RB26DETT
facts: Inline-6, DOHC 24-valve, iron block, aluminum head, belt-driven cams
280 PS (276 hp) at 6,800 rpm, 392 Nm (289 lb-ft) at 4,400 rpm in the R34
Two turbos in parallel with ceramic turbine wheels; the R34 got ball-bearing units
Six individual throttle bodies instead of one

issues.x: PistonHeads lists failing coil packs as an R34 weak spot, and names plugs, coil packs and airflow meters as the usual causes of poor running on the R33.
PistonHeads lists splitting vacuum lines as one of the R34 engine weak spots.

The stock turbos have ceramic turbine wheels, which Wikipedia says are weak at high boost. PistonHeads warns that overspinning a turbo can break the wheel off its shaft, and that a noisy turbo points to worn bearings.

PistonHeads says crankcase pressure can push oil past the turbos into the intake, and too much oil in the head can starve the sump and spin a bearing. It says to change the oil at least every 6,000 miles.
